# Decisions: drift-certification

- 2026-08-07T08:36:22.189Z — chose **Trap-based M4-rate certification with denominator = sprung traps only, cross-model write/resume arms, and upper-bound-only reporting (rule of three)** over re-running S2/R04 as-is on 0.23.0, or counting every injected decision as an opportunity because Binary M4 pass/fail cannot yield a rate at any n; counting unsprung decisions manufactures a low percentage from untested absences (6 decisions x 10 sessions = 60 fake opportunities).
